steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: GCSE Latin verse set texts are prescribed by each exam board and change every two years. Check which texts are current for your exam year. | Key Fact: Common verse authors include Virgil (Aeneid), Ovid (Metamorphoses), Catullus (poems), and Horace (Odes and Satires). | Key Fact: Virgil's Aeneid is the national epic of Rome, telling how Aeneas fled Troy and founded the Roman race in Italy. Key themes: pietas, fate, the cost of empire. | Key Fact: Ovid's Metamorphoses tells myths of transformation, often with wit, irony, and playful subversion of epic conventions.
